gate: Only earlier user turns sharing at least one lexical-v1 non-stopword query term may compete in the unchanged recurrent cosine top-two. Always retain latest three, stream all summaries/state updates in source order, and use the unchanged 512-token whole-turn fit.
checkpoint_policy: Reuse exact successor weights, no new training; bind a separate v3 implementation identity and checkpoint provenance manifest.
development_policy: Only the exact seven v2 development questions plus first-case deterministic replay. No new questions or held-out contents loaded. Never tune again after v3 answers.

success_criteria.technical: All three fresh workers finish 7 questions plus replay, match original v2 prompts/answers in before and lexical controls, and pass resource/identity/preservation checks.
success_criteria.development_diagnostic: After retains all 6 known required-evidence sets, improves over before's 1/7, has no additional wrong cases versus fresh lexical, and copies the literal and preserves the flower correctly. Report failures of each condition; no research/generalization PASS follows even if all pass.

cost_policy: Record every raw prompt/source/token/answer/score/error, proposed and fitted indices, gate trace, CPU/wall selection/generation/request/cold stage, process-tree memory and all failures. Report sums with and without charged replays. Selection tracing is applied to all three arms. No new training; inherited profile/training is disclosed separately without claiming training RAM or amortized efficiency. Shared audit/registration/testing costs remain separately identified.
